title: Second-Day Weekday Multiple — Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Additional Days
content:
For a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental contract, the second-day weekday multiple depends on the weekday on which the contract's second rental day began, which is the day after the actual pickup date: a Saturday or Sunday multiplies the additional-day rate by **1.2**, a Friday by **1.1**, and any other weekday by one.

| Actual pickup date falls on | Second rental day begins on | Multiple applied to the additional-day rate |
|---|---|---|
| Sunday | Monday | 1 |
| Monday | Tuesday | 1 |
| Tuesday | Wednesday | 1 |
| Wednesday | Thursday | 1 |
| Thursday | Friday | 1.1 |
| Friday | Saturday | 1.2 |
| Saturday | Sunday | 1.2 |

## Points of reading

- The weekday is fixed by the actual pickup date, not by the scheduled pickup date and not by the return date.
- A contract picked up on a Saturday has its second rental day begin on a Sunday and takes 1.2.
- Illustration (hypothetical): an additional-day rate of 24.95 on a contract picked up on a Thursday is multiplied by 1.1, giving 27.445 for each whole additional day before any rounding; the charge is rounded to the cent only once, on the final amount.
